blocks.text: Half-restored floors meet at incompatible heights and bruise a visitor.
Location: The Half-Restored Palace of Floors
Appearance: Narrow lower-body slices are displaced to different heights along a stepped fracture, then settle independently.
Care: Use injury supplies and the recovery time shown in Care.
Story connection: A future restoration route could recover the palace’s original floor order.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.
